It seems the docker daemon restarted or connection dropped. Let me check whether the build process is still running and whether daemon is healthy.

Actually the issue: `docker compose build` background process was killed when the previous terminal command returned exit code 1 (the [An error occurred during execution] message). This may be because the tool kills background processes. Let me check images built so far.
